## Frequently asked questions
## What counts as a session?
A session is counted each time you generate an AI note or schedule a session with a client, regardless of which method you use. Telehealth calls made through Upheal also count as sessions, even without a note, since your per-session fee includes the full platform: scheduling, secure payments, AI Assistant, and more. Imported sessions from another EHR are never counted or charged.
## How do I request a refund due to a session issue?
Most of the time, Upheal automatically recognizes when a session shouldn’t be charged. For example, if a client doesn’t show up, and you remove the appointment from your calendar, our system will know the session didn’t happen. The same applies if AI note processing fails; you won’t be charged. You can always see your current spend in Settings > Plan and billing . However, if we miss something, like a canceled appointment left on your calendar, or a note that didn’t meet your needs, just reach out to Support and let us know. We’ll make sure you’re not charged for that session by issuing a credit to your invoice.
## When and how will I be charged?
The billing period follows calendar months. You’ll be charged for a month’s sessions on the first day of the following month. (For example, you’ll be charged on May 1st for all sessions conducted in April.)
## Can multiple providers use the same Upheal account?
Multiple providers cannot share an Upheal account. Sharing an account would be a breach of our Terms of Service, and in that case, Upheal reserves the right to suspend or terminate the account.
## What happens if I stop using the paid version of Upheal?
If you switch to our Free plan, you’ll still have access to all your notes and records, but you won’t be able to use features only included in our Premium plan.
## What happens if I have outstanding payments?
If you haven’t paid for your Upheal subscription past the grace period we provide, you’ll still be able to see and export your records, but you won’t be able to use any of Upheal’s other features, or switch to our Free plan, until your balance is paid.
## How does the 30-day money back guarantee work?
If you realize that Upheal isn’t the right fit for you, just contact support within 30 days of subscribing to a paid plan, and we’ll refund your payment or cancel pending charges.
## Are there any fees beyond the $1/session price?
$1/session covers your note, plus access to all of Upheal’s features. If you’re processing online payments through Stripe, a fee of 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction applies. For insurance billing, a fee of $0.30 per claim submission, $0.15 per eligibility check. *Free till end of September
## Does my free trial end early if I subscribe to Premium?
If you subscribe to the Premium during your free trial, you won’t be charged for sessions conducted during your remaining trial days.
## Can I see the previous subscription plans?
We changed how pricing works very recently. If you’re still on our flat-rate Starter or Premium plan and would like to see the details, you can do so here . If we haven’t already, we’ll contact you in the future about switching over to the new subscription system.
## What should I do if I’m already on a paid monthly or annual plan?
When you’re ready to switch to usage-based pricing, reach out to Support. If we haven’t already, we’ll contact you in the future about switching over to the new subscription system. When you switch from a monthly paid plan, the new pay-per-session system will start once your current billing period ends. From then, you’ll pay $1 per session, and you’ll be charged at the start of the next calendar month. If you switch from an annual plan, we’ll apply a prorated credit to your account, which will be charged against per session until it runs out. If you’re on our Starter plan, you can stay on the plan with limited features for the time being, or contact Support to make the switch.
## Will I be charged sales tax?
Applicable taxes may be charged depending on your billing location and tax status. Where required by law, Upheal will calculate and collect applicable sales tax, GST, HST, VAT, or similar indirect taxes at the time of billing. If your organization qualifies for a tax exemption, please contact our team and provide the relevant exemption documentation for review.
## Can I pause my subscription?
Since you only pay for what you use, there’s no need to pause! You can cancel any time and return whenever you’re ready. You’ll still have access to all your records on our Free plan while you’re away.
## Does Upheal offer any discounts?
Yes — we offer two discount programs: ‍ Students & Associates — Get 50% off your first 12 months of Upheal. After starting your free trial, reach out to our Support team with a photo or screenshot of your student or associate status and we'll apply the discount to your account. ‍ Nonprofits — Upheal is proud to partner with organizations dedicated to healing and community. If your practice operates as a nonprofit, reach out to us to request a discount for your team.

## Why therapists use Golden Thread

Golden Thread is built by compliance experts and reviewed against top payer guidelines, so that you can be confident that your documentation holds up without second-guessing your notes. Reduce audit risk and streamline your workflow, worry-free.
## Your most popular FAQs
## What is the Golden Thread in therapy documentation?
The Golden Thread is the continuous, documented connection between a client's diagnosis, treatment plan goals, and session-by-session progress notes. Payers and auditors look for this thread to confirm medical necessity. Upheal's AI-native EHR maintains the Golden Thread automatically by linking treatment plan goals to progress notes after every session.
## How much does Upheal's treatment planning cost?
Treatment planning is included in Upheal's mental health EHR at $1 per session , capped at $69 per month. No add-on fee. AI notes, scheduling, billing, and client records are all included.
## How does Upheal generate treatment plans?
Upheal generates treatment plans automatically from your session notes and transcripts, so you can be sure they're accurate. Select previous notes or intake data, and Upheal creates a personalised plan with SMART goals, objectives, and interventions. Plans can be customised across 70+ modalities.
## Does Upheal support different therapy modalities?
Yes. Upheal supports 70+ modalities including CBT, DBT, ACT, psychodynamic, and trauma-focused therapy. Treatment plan templates and progress notes adapt to your clinical approach.
## Are Upheal treatment plans insurance compliant?
Yes. Templates are built by compliance experts and reviewed against top payer documentation criteria to support medical necessity and reduce audit risk. Upheal's Compliance Checker flags documentation gaps before you submit.

## From signed note to paid claim
## Check eligibility, submit claims, and match payments automatically, all inside the same platform that writes your notes. Pay per claim, with no monthly billing fee.

Everything in one place
## Billing that's built in, not bolted on
Your EHR knows the session happened. Your notes tool knows what you did. Your clearinghouse knows what you billed. Upheal is one system, so a finished note becomes a claim, a claim becomes a payment, next to the session it came from.
## One platform, zero re-entry
Claims are autopopulated from your provider profile, the session, and the client's insurance. Nothing to copy, nothing to paste.
## No monthly billing fee
Billing isn't a subscription add-on. You pay per claim, only when you bill. ‍
## One loop for claims, eligibility, and ERAs
Enroll your payers once. Claims, eligibility checks, and ERAs all run through one built-in connection, no separate clearinghouse to manage.
## Built with billing pros, backed by real people
Built side by side with professional billers, so payer rules and real world know-how are baked into every flag.
How it works
## Set up once, then it does the heavy lifting
Eligibility checks
## Know what's covered before the first session
Run an eligibility check inside Upheal for a detailed view of coverage: copays, deductibles, and mental health details when the payer provides them. No payer portal logins needed.
$0.15 per check. That's it.
Payments
## See what you expected. See what you got paid.
With ERA enrollment, payments match to claims automatically, no manual reconciliation. Because your contracted rates live in Upheal, every session shows expected insurance payment, client responsibility, and write-off. When the ERA arrives, we recalculate and show expected vs. paid, so quiet underpayment doesn't stay quiet.
Keeping your current clearinghouse for now? No problem. Post payments manually from your EOBs or ERAs and keep your books in Upheal while you transition at your own pace.
Billing hub
## Every session shows you where the money stands
On every session, the billing hub shows client responsibility, expected insurance payment, and write-off in real time. Open any client and see their balance: what they owe, and what insurance still owes you. So you know exactly when to act, and when to relax.
Client insurance
## Insurance details, collected without the back-and-forth
Each client's profile holds primary and secondary insurance, so you can bill both through Upheal. Collect ROI and AOB through digital forms, and let clients snap and upload insurance cards. No more "can you email me a photo of the back, too?"
Denials
## Denied claim? Upheal drafts the appeal.
When a claim gets denied, Upheal drafts an appeal for you, pulling the relevant information from the client's chart to establish medical necessity and address the denial reason. What used to be an evening of digging through notes becomes a review-and-send.
AI Assistant
## "Which claims need my attention this week?"
Upheal Assistant knows your clients, your sessions, and your claims. Ask it to check on a claim, find unbilled sessions, or explain a balance, in plain language, without opening a report.
Cleaner notes, cleaner claims
## Billing is only as good as the note behind it
Denials usually start in documentation, not billing. Upheal checks notes against payer requirements before you sign, and treatment plans keep the golden thread intact, so your claim is backed by a chart that holds up, billing from the same place your notes live.
Pricing
## Pay per claim, not per month
Legacy EHRs charge you a monthly fee whether you bill or not. Upheal charges per claim, so you only pay when you bill.
$0.30
per claim submission
$0.15
per eligibility check
$0.00
monthly billing fee
Launch offer: Free claims and eligibility checks till the end of September
Try for free
## Your most popular FAQs
## Do I keep my own payer contracts?
Yes. You bill under your own NPI, with your own payer contracts and rates. Upheal gives you the tools to submit claims, check eligibility, and track everything in one place. Your payer relationships stay yours.
## Do I need a separate clearinghouse?
No. Clearinghouse connectivity is built into Upheal, the same way a payment processor handles card networks for you behind the scenes. Enroll a payer for electronic claims, eligibility checks, and ERAs, and everything runs through one loop. If you'd rather keep your current clearinghouse for now, you can. Just post payments manually from your EOBs or ERAs.
## Do I have to learn billing to use it?
No. Claims fill themselves in from your notes and client details, problems are flagged before you submit, and payments match themselves when the ERA arrives. If a payer rejects something, you'll see why in plain terms. And when you're not sure about anything, ask the Assistant, or get a real person on a call.
## What does it cost?
Launch offer: Free claims and eligibilty checks till the end of September. Applicable only for solo practicies. ‍ iInsurance billing is usage-based: $0.30 per claim submission and $0.15 per eligibility check. There's no setup cost and no monthly fee beyond your usual per-session pricing.
## Can I bill for clients with secondary insurance?
Yes. Each client's profile holds their primary and secondary insurance, and you can bill secondary claims through Upheal, so clients with two plans don't mean two workflows.
## What happens if a claim is denied?
You'll see the denial next to the session it belongs to, along with the reason, and Upheal will draft an appeal for you, pulling relevant information from the client's chart to establish medical necessity. You review, edit if needed, and send.

## You shouldn't have to choose between doing your own billing and giving up your practice
Do it yourself, and billing takes 5 to 10 hours of your week. Join a marketplace, and someone else owns your contracts and rates. There's a third option now.
## Doing it yourself
Claims, denials, patient balances. It adds up to 10+ hours a week, roughly a third of claims denied on first submission, and 50+ days waiting to get paid.
## Marketplace platforms
They hold your payer contracts and set your rates. And when their eligibility check gets it wrong, the clawback lands on your paycheck, months later.
## Upheal Managed Billing
Full revenue cycle management under your own NPI. Your contracts, your rates, your clients. We do the work. ‍
What you get
## Billing that starts with the note
Because Upheal writes your documentation, we know what happened in the session before the claim is filed. No standalone billing service can copy that loop.
## Clean claims, faster collections
Your biller reviews coding before submission. Denials get prevented at the source, not chased after the fact. No clawback surprises.
## Your contracts, your independence
We bill under your NPI with your payer contracts and your negotiated rates. You never hand a contract or a client to a platform.
## The complete billing loop
AI drafts your insurance-ready note. You sign it. Our team handles eligibility, claims, denials, appeals, and remittances, end to end.

## Not credentialed on your own yet? We'll help you get there.
On marketplace platforms, the platform holds the payer contracts. We'll help you get credentialed in your own name, then take the billing from there. And unlike a platform, nothing gets locked in: your notes, records, and billing history are yours and exportable anytime.
Let us know on the waitlist form , and we'll include credentialing in your onboarding plan.
Pricing
## One simple rate. Everything included.
Most billing services make you call for a quote. We won't. You pay 5.9% of what we collect for you, and nothing else. For context: running billing in-house costs the average practice around 11% of collections once software, admin time, and lost clinical hours are counted.

## Your most popular FAQs
## Do I keep my own payer contracts?
Yes, always. We bill under your NPI, with your contracts and your negotiated rates. Your payer relationships stay yours, and so do your records: notes and billing history are exportable anytime.
## What does it cost
5.9% of what we collect for you. No setup fees, no per-claim charges, no monthly minimum during beta. If you don't get paid, neither do we.
## How is this different from Headway, Grow, or Rula?
Marketplaces hold your payer contracts and take a share of every session, often 20 to 30% of session revenue. We charge 5.9% of collections and you keep your own contracts and rates.
## What about clawbacks and payer audits?
Two layers of protection. First, your claims are coded from your actual session documentation, so they hold up when a payer looks back. Second, because the contracts are yours, you have full appeal rights, and we do the appeal work for you. No surprise deductions from a platform paycheck.
## How much work is left for me?
Sign your notes and glance at your reports. Plan on under 30 minutes a week.
## Do I need to use Upheal as my EHR?
Yes. The advantage is the loop between your documentation and your claims, and that only works on one platform. If you're on Upheal for notes only, we'll help you move the rest over during onboarding, free.
## Which payers do you support?
Commercial payers, in-network and out-of-network, US-based practices. Medicare and Medicaid are on the roadmap.
## Does Managed Billing collect payments from cash-pay clients too?
It's designed to take the insurance burden off your plate. But if you'd like, we're happy to serve the cash-pay side of your practice as well.
## Who actually does the billing, a person or an AI?
Both, on purpose. A senior behavioral health biller runs your account and handles anything requiring judgment. AI accelerates the routine work, which is how we keep the rate low without cutting corners.
## Your notes are already done. Let the billing be next.

## Frequently asked questions
## What counts as a session?
A session is counted each time you generate an AI note or schedule a session with a client, regardless of which method you use. Telehealth calls made through Upheal also count as sessions, even without a note, since your per-session fee includes the full platform: scheduling, secure payments, AI Assistant, and more. Imported sessions from another EHR are never counted or charged.
## How do I request a refund due to a session issue?
Most of the time, Upheal automatically recognizes when a session shouldn’t be charged. For example, if a client doesn’t show up, and you remove the appointment from your calendar, our system will know the session didn’t happen. The same applies if AI note processing fails; you won’t be charged. You can always see your current spend in Settings > Plan and billing . However, if we miss something, like a canceled appointment left on your calendar, or a note that didn’t meet your needs, just reach out to Support and let us know. We’ll make sure you’re not charged for that session by issuing a credit to your invoice.
## When and how will I be charged?
The billing period follows calendar months. You’ll be charged for a month’s sessions on the first day of the following month. (For example, you’ll be charged on May 1st for all sessions conducted in April.)
## Can multiple providers use the same Upheal account?
Multiple providers cannot share an Upheal account. Sharing an account would be a breach of our Terms of Service, and in that case, Upheal reserves the right to suspend or terminate the account.
## What happens if I stop using the paid version of Upheal?
If you switch to our Free plan, you’ll still have access to all your notes and records, but you won’t be able to use features only included in our Premium plan.
## What happens if I have outstanding payments?
If you haven’t paid for your Upheal subscription past the grace period we provide, you’ll still be able to see and export your records, but you won’t be able to use any of Upheal’s other features, or switch to our Free plan, until your balance is paid.
